PDF.js 5.4.624 official legacy build from `pdfjs-dist`.

The main module and worker are paired files from the same published archive.
This build includes the upstream compatibility layer required by the desktop
workbench's Chromium 108 renderer. The modern files remain in `../pdfjs`.
